_doc: Presentation metadata for workflow folders — the ORDER verbs appear in and the glyph each carries. Served so the client stops hard-coding either (Daniel, 2026-08-28: 'make it served, and therefore editable later'). Order is the route work actually takes: prepare the image, find the regions, read them, clean the reading, translate it, describe and extract, then catalogue, organise, export. A folder absent from this list sorts after the known route and takes the fallback glyph, so a user's own folder still appears rather than vanishing.
